$comment: Claude's own opening selections. Written and committed to disk before Codex's blind run for this gameweek (protocol.md). Probability estimates were formed from team-news/form research before the market prices were used for anything beyond computing edge against them -- prices were already visible from the research pass (Claude did the odds research itself), so true price-blindness isn't achievable for the human-facing narrative reasoning below; the discipline enforced instead is: the stated probability was written down before edge was computed, and was not revised after seeing how large the resulting edge was, per methodology section 7.
estimate_method: Qualitative, form-and-injury-adjusted probability estimate: recent-form base rate (points/goals this season) adjusted for home advantage and the specific injury/availability news gathered for each side. This is NOT a fitted statistical model (no Poisson goal model, no xG data pulled) -- it is a reasoned qualitative estimate, and Claude flags that it should not be trusted at the same confidence level as a quantitative model, especially where it disagrees with the market by a wide margin.

selections.reasoning: Coventry bottom of the table, 0 goals scored in 3 games, 5 conceded, missing Wright/Kesler-Hayden/Woolfenden/Cherif. Brighton missing a long list of attacking players (Minteh, Mitoma, Ferguson, Tzimas among others) and have lost their last three league away games specifically, despite good overall form. The gap is real but Brighton's away form and depleted attack narrow it more than the raw table position suggests.
selections.decision_reason: edge clears 3pp threshold, though narrowly -- within the likely error bars of a qualitative estimate; low confidence
selections.team_news_note: Confirmed = credible recent injury/availability reporting from multiple outlets, not the hour-before teamsheet, which isn't out yet for any fixture in this batch. This reading of 'confirmed' is not settled in spec/methodology.md -- flagged for the owner.
selections.provisional_note: Set from pre-match injury/doubt reporting, not the official starting lineup. Per methodology.md section 6 (decided 13 Sept 2026), this must be re-checked against the confirmed teamsheet (~1hr before kickoff) before the bet is placed.
selections.actual_lineup_check_note: Official confirmed lineups published (101greatgoals.com, corroborated by other outlets citing the same XIs; Lampard and Hurzeler both confirmed via post-teamsheet quotes). Coventry XI as expected minus Wright/Kesler-Hayden/Woolfenden (Josh Eccles also out, not previously listed); Sidiki Cherif is fit and among the substitutes -- the assumption that he was absent was wrong, but he did not start, so it does not change the picture. Brighton XI confirms all previously assumed absentees (Minteh, Mitoma, Hinshelwood, Wieffer, Tzimas, Ferguson, Yohanna) still out; neither possible returnee (Azeez, Rutter) started. No material change to the picture -- probability estimate held at 0.28. Re-fetched Bet365 match-result odds (oddschecker.com): Coventry 14/5 (3.80), Draw 29/10 (3.90), Brighton 9/10 (1.90) -- draw price unchanged, edge recomputed against the refreshed market odds via scripts/edge_calculator.py.

selections.reasoning: Coventry have not scored in three league games. Weighted that heavily.
selections.decision_reason: edge_implausible_model_uncertainty -- a 24-point disagreement with a liquid market, on the first-ever run of an unvalidated qualitative method, is far more likely to be Claude's estimate being wrong than a genuine mispricing. Recording the number honestly rather than quietly rounding it down, but recommending against treating this as real edge. Not adjusted after the fact to a smaller number -- declined outright instead, per methodology's own warning against a book that always agrees with itself.

Landed close to Opta's own supercomputer figures (City 44.2/Utd 31.6/Draw 24.2), which is itself a signal there's little differentiated view here.

selections.reasoning: Both sides can score, but City's defensive solidity under Maresca and Utd's inconsistent attack (1 win from 3) make a City-dominant, Utd-shut-out scoreline plausible enough that the market's 64.5% fair BTTS-yes looks a little high.
selections.decision_reason: edge clears 3pp threshold with a moderate, plausible-sized disagreement (not an outlier like the Coventry BTTS figure)

selections.actual_lineup_check_note: Official confirmed lineups published ~55min before kickoff (101greatgoals.com 'Confirmed line-ups and team news', corroborated by lastwordonsports.com, athlonsports.com and search-aggregated Sky Sports/BBC-sourced reporting). Man Utd XI: Lammens; Dalot, Maguire, Martinez, Dorgu; Tielemans, Mainoo; Mbeumo, Fernandes, Rashford; Cunha -- Baleba, de Ligt, Ugarte, Heaton and Amad Diallo all still out as assumed (club confirmed Amad out; Baleba/de Ligt carrying a 20 Sept return date), and Shaw's doubt resolved to a confirmed absence (Dorgu starts at left-back instead of the assumed Shaw start/doubt). Man City XI: Donnarumma, Nunes, Dias (C), Guehi, Gvardiol, Anderson, Fernandez, Foden, Cherki, Semenyo, Haaland -- full strength as assumed; O'Reilly fit but named among substitutes, not a negative signal. No material change to the picture; probability estimate held at 0.42 (btts_no). Re-fetched BTTS odds (bet365, via oddschecker.com and corroborating outlets): Yes 4/9 (1.444 decimal) confirmed directly; No price not independently re-quoted by any source found, so backed out via the unchanged overround (0.0735) implied by the confirmed Yes price -- this reproduces the original No price of 2.625 exactly, indicating the BTTS market has not moved. Edge recomputed via scripts/edge_calculator.py against this price: unchanged at +6.51pp, still clears the 3pp threshold. Selection remains taken.

selections.reasoning: Leeds winless in 3 in all competitions but decent underlying start (5 pts from 3). Newcastle unbeaten in 5 under new manager Jaissle and won both away games this season, but missing Joelinton and Dan Burn for certain, plus goalkeeper and full-back doubts -- real defensive depletion for an away side.
selections.decision_reason: edge clears 3pp threshold, narrowly -- low confidence
